title: Argentinian Peach Empanadas
description: Sweet and savory empanadas filled with caramelized peaches, a classic Argentinian dessert.
instructions: 2. Roll out the warm empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
3. Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the caramelized peaches, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
5. Place a tablespoon of the peach mixture in the center of each dough circle.
6. Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
7. Brush the tops of the empanadas with the unsalted butter and sprinkle with flaky sea salt.
8. Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
